svg.title: Entry Revenue and Spend Without a False Profit Total
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-entry-funnel-revenue-and-spend; chapter number: 3; title: Entry Revenue and Spend Without a False Profit Total; subtitle: Separate Jay Neyer's annual paid-experience results from Jamie McAdam's daily low-ticket test.; caption: Jay Neyer reports birthday-booking and play-pass revenue; Jamie McAdam recalls daily entry-funnel sales and advertising spend from a separate test.; assumptions note: Jay Neyer's annual figures and Jamie McAdam's daily figures are independent reported amounts. Every bar is a standalone total, not a cumulative waterfall adjustment. The combined paid-experience figure overlaps the component categories.; note: Jay Neyer's 'over' amounts retain their reported thresholds. Jamie McAdam's daily sales range does not establish high-ticket purchases, complete operating costs, or net profit.; chart type: waterfall; bars: label: Birthday booking revenue; value: 120000; display: Over $120,000 in 365 days; kind: total; label: Play-pass revenue; value: 90000; display: Over $90,000 in 365 days; kind: total; label: Combined paid-experience revenue; value: 211000; display: Over $211,000 in 365 days; kind: total; label: Daily entry sales lower endpoint; value: 150; display: $150 daily sales range endpoint; kind: total; label: Daily entry sales upper endpoint; value: 200; display: $200 daily sales range endpoint; kind: total; label: Daily advertising spend; value: 37; display: About $37 per day; kind: total
